remarks: Sunny luxury waterfront/pond condo in Georgetowne North featuring 3 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and a finished third floor with full bath and skylights. Fully renovated with exceptional taste, this residence stands apart from traditional condominium offerings. Spacious living and dining areas showcase serene pond views and seamless flow for everyday living and entertaining. Beautifully updated kitchen and refined finishes throughout. Private patio overlooks the park-like grounds surrounding and picturesque pond. Ideally located close to town, train, and shops. Turnkey elegance in a premier setting.
